text: Exact performance is now constitutional. Conceptual unity, statistical validity, and computational efficiency are coequal requirements. The compiler must seek creative algebraic elimination, factorization, sparsity, query fusion, streaming, and matrix-free action; each optimized lowering must preserve the declared estimand against an independent oracle and pass regime-specific runtime, peak-memory, and materialization gates. Approximate, randomized, or reduced-precision paths require a distinct estimator identity and explicit error contract. Beauty means fewer concepts and fewer computations.
